memberdef.name: rlist_foreach_entry
memberdef.initializer: for (item = rlist_first_entry((head), typeof(*item), member); \ &item->member != (head); \ item = rlist_next_entry((item), member))

memberdef.name: rlist_foreach_entry_safe
memberdef.initializer: for ((item) = rlist_first_entry((head), typeof(*item), member); \ &item->member != (head) && \ ((tmp) = rlist_next_entry((item), member)); \ (item) = (tmp))

memberdef.name: rlist_foreach_entry_safe_reverse
memberdef.initializer: for ((item) = rlist_last_entry((head), typeof(*item), member); \ &item->member != (head) && \ ((tmp) = rlist_prev_entry((item), member)); \ (item) = (tmp))
